guard: a report aligns by display width, becomes labeled records when the terminal is too narrow, wraps long values, lines and warnings at spaces with each continuation under its text, escapes untrusted text, keeps state words in plain output and draws its punctuation there in ASCII, and writes one result as the envelope or as its report
why: Each mutation restores one way a terminal report can mislead: misaligned columns, a clipped or overflowing table, untrusted text that rewrites the screen, a state shown only by color or a mark, or a result whose warnings vanish. The suite imports the workspace package through its build, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
